title: Your Morning Commute Is Stealing $12,800 a Year
hook: Your morning commute feels harmless — but most Americans have no idea it's quietly draining over twelve thousand dollars a year.
angle: Most people only think about time wasted — not the $5,360 in car costs, $730 in commute coffees, $1,100 in office lunches, and $370 in work clothes that silently stack up to a $2.2 million retirement hole over 30 years.
audience: Commuters aged 25-50 who have never done the full math on what their daily drive actually costs in dollars, not just time
key_numbers: $12,800: total annual commute cost (car costs + hidden extras)
225: hours per year wasted in traffic, equal to 28 full work days
$5,360: annual car cost alone at IRS rate of $0.67/mile for 32 miles/day
$2.2M: what that $12,800/year becomes invested over 30 years at 10%
73%: percentage of US workers who commute by car alone daily
